verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Gunderson Dettmer runs client-facing software platforms (GDHQ, Contract Generator, Catalyze, D&O Portal), so an official MCP server is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows one. ChatGD is an internal attorney chat app built on Azure OpenAI, not an MCP endpoint, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
